WITH school_records AS (
    SELECT f."School Type" AS school_type,
           COALESCE(f."School Name", s.School) AS school_name,
           COALESCE(f."School Type", s.SOCType) AS classification,
           s.Latitude
    FROM schools AS s
    LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.State = 'CA'
), middle_schools AS (
    SELECT school_type, school_name, Latitude
    FROM school_records
    WHERE classification IN ('Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)', 'Junior High Schools (Public)')
       OR (school_name LIKE '%middle%' AND school_name NOT LIKE '%middle college%')
       OR school_name LIKE '%intermediate%'
       OR school_name LIKE '%junior high%'
       OR school_name LIKE '%jr. high%'
       OR school_name LIKE '%jr high%'
)
SELECT school_type AS "School Type", school_name AS "School Name", Latitude
FROM middle_schools
WHERE Latitude = (SELECT MAX(Latitude) FROM middle_schools)
ORDER BY school_name;
```

```sql
WITH eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s.CDSCode,
        s.School AS school_name,
        s.Charter AS charter,
        s.GSserved AS grades_served,
        1.0 * f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS free_meal_rate,
        t.AvgScrRead + t.AvgScrMath + t.AvgScrWrite AS sat_total
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
      AND (TRIM(s.GSserved) = '12' OR TRIM(s.GSserved) LIKE '%-12')
)
SELECT
    school_name AS "School Name",
    ROUND(free_meal_rate, 4) AS "Free Meal Rate",
    CASE charter WHEN 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "Charter School",
    grades_served AS "Grades Served",
    CASE
        WHEN sat_total IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
        WHEN sat_total < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN sat_total <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS "SAT Performance Level"
FROM eligible_schools
WHERE free_meal_rate = (SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) FROM eligible_schools)
ORDER BY school_name, CDSCode;
```

WITH RECURSIVE months(month_start) AS (
    VALUES ('2010-01-01')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month')
    FROM months
    WHERE month_start < '2010-12-01'
),
monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT m.month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT p.Id) AS post_count
    FROM months AS m
    LEFT JOIN postLinks AS l
        ON l.CreationDate >= m.month_start
       AND l.CreationDate < date(m.month_start, '+1 month')
    LEFT JOIN posts AS p
        ON p.Id = l.RelatedPostId
       AND p.AnswerCount <= 2
    GROUP BY m.month_start
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(post_count), 2) AS average_monthly_post_count
FROM monthly_counts;
```

                AND CAST(r.mg_dl_text AS REAL) >= 300
            )
        )
  );

    FROM "Laboratory"

      AND u.amount NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*'
      AND u.amount NOT GLOB '*.*.*'
      AND CAST(u.amount AS REAL) >= 100
)
ORDER BY p."ID";
